interpretation: Obligations, not a fixed number of tests, commits, types or projects.

groups.requirement: Current checkout, sibling/source/mode tuple and protected work are recorded; no reset to the review SHA.
Local PGP unlock is requested at entry and coherent tested signed commits are verified incrementally.
All current production rendering roots and evaluated/linked items are reconciled with the existing inventories.
Routes, C# renderers, dynamic/dialog/deferred/contributor descendants and compatibility activations have explicit owners.
Light renderer public types and actual evaluated direct/transitive/runtime dependencies are free of forbidden native edges; unresolved inputs are not called passes.
Both dashboard routes preserve quick actions, identity-bearing links, recent/active meanings, usage and cost uncertainty.
Native snapshot/cache/timer ownership, manual retry, stale display, independent tab state and disposal remain correct.
Full Runtime Capabilities and CapabilityFact presentation is independent while native readiness probes and every status meaning remain unchanged.
Database startup/runtime/selected/active/pending/config-lock states and all current actions retain their distinctions.
Only safe profile display/copy data crosses the seam; synthetic fixture secrets are absent from browser/evidence output.
Native activation-for-restart, selection identity, busy/admission and delayed outcome behavior are preserved without a live-switch shortcut.
Actual utilities/database flyout and status top bar use suitable light renderers with real children and callbacks.
Startup routed-body gating, navigation/tabs, context, floating conversations, notifications and framework recovery remain owned and functional.
Every further feasible in-scope active residual found in the current census is implemented in this task, not merely put in a new bundle.
Native/framework/compatibility/marker classifications have evidence; no forced file-count extraction or unsupported deletion.
Current routes/public parameters/type identities and actual caller semantics are preserved or explicitly migrated with real consumer tests.
Affected drafts, EditContext, read lanes, rendered targets, accepted/unknown outcomes and two-view/late completion boundaries remain safe.
Independent scenario host uses the same complete renderers without native/module/DB registrations and covers meaningful non-happy states.
Affected owner/component/integration tests verify native effects/readback rather than only a fake callback.
Fresh dashboard/readiness/profile/native startup browser journeys verify actual interactions and honest layer labels.
Current cross-family shell/navigation/deferred-overlay coverage is complete; affected real workflow/process/chat/file/collaboration paths are exercised.
Moved source and published assets, CSS/Tailwind, JS, icons, focus/scroll/overlay behavior and route discovery are verified.
Representative comparable startup/watch/edit-visible measurements and restart limitations are recorded without fabricated speedups.
Current boundary/inventory guards reject relevant negative controls without architecture-by-filename or interface/file-count quotas.
CodeAnalytics coverage and complementary impact analysis select actual owning tests with current builds and verified discovery.
Every reused prior proof has a valid source/dependency/fixture/asset rationale and is never counted as fresh execution.
Final broad integration policy decision, all required test/static/doc/portability gates and retained original failures are explicitly closed.
PC4 captured launch, retained-origin refusal/reuse and role-resource behavior stay intact; unrelated Process work is not restarted.
Standard Debug/Release outputs, serialized builds and reusable isolated fixtures prevent new output/DB accumulation; protected resources stay untouched.
Current complete closure/family/evidence register and maintained indexes live outside shared; no replacement shared archive/version requirement is introduced.
Separate native transfer/paging/backend/release limitations and stable seam/owner invariants are handed to the next refactor without hidden scope expansion.
Final completion dimensions, verified source/report ancestry and exact resource disposition satisfy the stated end conditions or honestly identify blockers.
